header: From empty page to published in four steps
subheadline: This is how editors work with Desiderio every day. No step needs a developer.

items.title: Open the content wizard
items.description: Choose from 244 elements in ten groups, from Hero to Footers.

items.title: Fill in the guided fields
items.description: Each element has clear fields, hints and limits. Editors never write raw HTML, so the layout can't break.

items.title: Check the backend preview
items.description: The page module shows a real preview of every element, so layout problems show up before publishing.

items.title: Publish on brand
items.description: The active theme preset styles the element, so it matches the rest of the site.
